svg.title: Four methods on the same rugged landscape
svg.desc: The same profile of h four times, once per method. Strict hill climbing slides into the first basin and stops. Random restart runs the same rule from three different starts and keeps the best of the three. Variable neighbourhood search reaches further from the basin it is stuck in, so a candidate beyond the ridge counts as a neighbour. Simulated annealing accepts some worse moves and climbs out of the basin it is in. All four keep exactly one current candidate at a time.
svg.text: ONE CANDIDATE AT A TIME · FOUR WAYS TO MOVE IT
stops at the first basin it reaches
one current solution at a time, repeated
three starts, keep the best of them
a wider neighbourhood reaches past the ridge
one current solution, a softer acceptance rule
climbs out, then settles as it cools
One path through the space, one candidate handed to the next: that is what makes all four trajectory methods.
